mathematics.assertion_tested: Bounded enumeration and algorithm comparisons described in experiments/README.md; output is the exact finite dataset, not a general theorem or novelty claim.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers and fractions over Q
mathematics.conventions: Row-major bipartite arrays; edge partitions via restricted-growth strings; distinct-term 3-AP sets; k vertices for color-coding; unnormalized edge expansion; walks start at vertex 0.
inputs: All labeled d-regular bipartite graphs for 1<=n<=5, 1<=d<=n
All partitions of K22 and K33 edges; full Aut(K33) action
All partitions of interval/cyclic domains of orders 3..9 and products (2,2),(2,4),(2,2,2)
All simple undirected graphs of orders 1..4 and all k^n vertex colorings for 1<=k<=n
K4, C6, K33, two disjoint triangles: cuts and walk times 0..8
non_claims: No novelty or current open-problem claim
